jobs.title: AI/ML Engineer
jobs.jd: About the Singapore AI Center of Excellence (COE) The Singapore AI Center of Excellence (COE) is a dedicated engineering and R&D hub focused on Enterprise and Sovereign AI. Our mission is to help organizations move AI workflows cleanly into production through two main paths: creating reusable software architectures that solve common industry problems, and contributing code directly to upstream open-source projects to fix enterprise gaps in system deployment, runtime tuning, and platform management. Basing our engineering team in Singapore creates a close feedback loop between customers, partners, and core product teams. This direct connection keeps our development roadmaps relevant, speeds up solution delivery, and strengthens our ability to co-innovate across the region. Role Overview The AI/ML Engineer is a highly technical, hands-on role at the intersection of Enterprise AI and client-facing architecture. As part of our Customer Engineering function, you will write production-grade solution blueprints alongside strategic customers and technology partners. Your mission is to solve immediate, high-stakes operational bottlenecks in the APAC region by delivering repeatable, extensible, and open-sourced AI Quickstarts that show the industry how to solve complex challenges. In this team, career growth and seniority are defined purely by your technical competence, architectural depth, and ability to deliver end-to-end solutions autonomously in highly ambiguous environments. There is no expectation of team management, project coordination, or formal talent mentorship; your progression is driven entirely by engineering impact. What You Will Do: Enterprise-Minded Blueprinting: Design and build comprehensive, production-ready architecture blueprints and reference codebases. These blueprints must naturally take into account critical enterprise requirements—including systems-level hardening, infrastructure scalability, and network isolation boundaries—without you needing to perform the last-mile hands-on production deployment yourself. Open-Source AI Quickstarts: Package repeatable, extensible technical architectures as open-sourced AI Quickstarts to solve complex, real-world industry problems and accelerate ecosystem adoption. Co-Development & Integration: Collaborate with external engineering teams (such as semiconductor partners, regional AI programs, and software vendors) to validate joint-architecture blueprints, ensuring stable integrations across the system stack. Benchmarking & Evaluation: Design and integrate automated testing, evaluation harnesses, and system-level telemetry into blueprints to monitor and measure performance metrics like latency, throughput, cost, and model quality. Regulated & Secure Design: Proactively incorporate robust data privacy standards, secure network perimeters, and localized hosting considerations into all solution blueprints to satisfy compliance and risk management requirements in highly regulated environments. What You Will Bring: Academic & Professional Experience Education: Bachelor’s or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related quantitative field. Software Engineering Foundations: Excellent understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including clean code principles, test-driven development (TDD), CI/CD automation pipelines, and version control (Git) workflows. Communication: Clear verbal and written communication skills in English, with the ability to articulate complex technical architectures to other engineers and technical stakeholders. Core Technical Stack Programming Languages: Exceptional, hands-on proficiency in Python (specifically for machine learning and systems programming). Solid familiarity with lower-level system languages such as Go or C/C++ is highly preferred. Deep Learning & ML Libraries: Strong familiarity with PyTorch and core NLP/vision ecosystems (e.g., Hugging Face Transformers, datasets, and tokenizers). Cloud-Native Frameworks: Strong practical experience deploying containerized applications on Kubernetes or production-grade enterprise container orchestration platforms. Base MLOps Knowledge: Conceptual and hands-on understanding of model serving lifecycles, data ingestion steps, and automated packaging. Target Knowledge Domains & Growth Areas We are building a multi-disciplinary engineering squad. Candidates are expected to bring experience in some of the following domains, and will have the opportunity to continuously develop their skills across all of them as they grow in seniority: Platform & Pipeline Engineering: Experience with distributed computing frameworks and cluster schedulers (such as Ray), workflow orchestration (such as MLflow or Kubeflow), distributed unstructured data parsing tools (such as Docling), and vector database structures. Generative AI & Agentic Architectures: Familiarity with LLM orchestration engines (such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or LangGraph), agentic workflows (AgentOps), tool-calling protocols (such as Model Context Protocol) and model fine-tuning (PEFT/SFT). Hardware Heterogeneity & Runtime Optimization: Understanding of model serving runtimes (such as vLLM), optimizing engines for latency and throughput (e.g., KV cache offloading, chunked prefill), and running benchmarks across diverse hardware setups including CUDA, ROCm, and emerging GPU/NPU architectures. Regulated Deployments: Designing isolated, air-gapped container networks, secure registry services, and local inference environments to meet strict data residency, privacy, and compliance policies. Nice-to-Have: Industry Domain Experience While not strictly required, experience applying AI/ML architectures to solve challenges in the following regulated industries is a strong advantage: Financial Services (FSI): Familiarity with risk-assessment models, fraud detection patterns, or compliance requirements under regulatory frameworks. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer | Finance
jobs.jd: Jij zorgt dat AI niet bij een financiële pilot blijft, maar helpt in het echte werk. Een slimme AI-demo maakt indruk. Maar pas als analisten en medewerkers er elke dag mee werken, wordt technologie waardevol. Zeker in finance, waar betrouwbaarheid, controleerbaarheid en regelgeving nooit bijzaak zijn. Als Senior Forward Deployed AI Engineer ben je erbij vanaf het eerste gesprek. Je brengt "we willen iets met AI" binnen weken terug tot een use case die je kunt testen, of je zegt eerlijk dat het (nog) niet kan. Daarna ontwerp en bouw je de oplossing en breng je hem live in cycli van dagen. En dan maak je jezelf overbodig. Wat ga je doen? Je slaat de brug tussen business en techniek: je zit aan tafel bij de klant, ontwerpt de oplossing en implementeert vaak ook zelf. Use cases scherp krijgen: samen met business development voer je discoverygesprekken, toets je use cases aan echte data en systemen en bouw je in dagen een proof-of-value. Ontwerpen en uitvoeren: je ontwerpt de agentic architectuur, kiest per situatie het patroon dat past en brengt de oplossing in korte cycli naar productie, samen met onze AI Engineers. Overdragen en meten: de klant kan de oplossing zelf draaien, en na go-live meet je of hij echt gebruikt wordt. Dát is je maatstaf. Ons slimmer maken: wat je leert, maak je herbruikbaar voor de volgende klant, en je helpt nieuwe FDE's op weg. Ongeveer 10% van je tijd gaat naar pre-sales en 90% naar delivery; business development is commercieel eigenaar. Van KYC tot complexe financiële processen Je kent de werkelijkheid achter KYC/AML, klantacceptatie, klachten- en schadeafhandeling, financiële rapportage, risk en compliance. Denk aan: KYC-dossiers die agents voorbereiden met herleidbare bronnen, zodat analisten sneller onderbouwd beslissen. Documenten en signalen die samenkomen voor een klachten- of schadeteam. Rapportages die nu handwerk zijn, geautomatiseerd binnen de kaders van DORA en de EU AI Act. Wat breng je mee? Aantoonbare ervaring in finance: je kent de processen, data, systemen en risico's van binnenuit. Je hebt AI-oplossingen met LLM's en agents ontworpen, in productie gebracht én onderhouden, inclusief evals, guardrails, monitoring en security. Sterk in Python en SQL, en hands-on met minimaal één cloud (Azure, AWS of GCP) en een dataplatform zoals Databricks, Snowflake of Fabric. Je werkt dagelijks met coding agents en beoordeelt kritisch wat ze opleveren. Ervaring in een klantgerichte rol, zoals consultancy, pre-sales, solutions engineering of je eigen startup. Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en Engels. Mooi meegenomen: ervaring met DORA, model risk management of audit trails, en met klassieke ML zoals fraude- en risicomodellen. Wat dit níet is Geen individuele detachering. Je werkt aan projecten namens adesso, met een team achter je. Geen PoC-kerkhof. We bouwen om te gebruiken. Geen slides zonder code. Je advies komt met een werkende versie. Geen agent omdat het kan. Soms is de simpelste oplossing de beste, en dat zeg je dan. Het team Je wordt onderdeel van ons AI Engineering-team: AI engineering consultants in twee rollen. De Forward Deployed AI Engineer (FDE) is eigenaar van het klantprobleem en ontwerpt de oplossing, inclusief de agentic architectuur. De AI Engineer gaat de diepte in op bouw, data, MLOps en schaal, en denkt vanaf de klantvraag mee over de juiste aanpak. Je krijgt ruimte om je eigen werk vorm te geven, maar je bent nooit alleen verantwoordelijk voor alle specialismen. Twijfel je welke rol het best bij je past? Solliciteer dan gewoon; we kijken samen. Waarom adesso? Omdat je bij ons écht kunt meebouwen. Bij adesso Nederland draait het om meer dan alleen technologie. We bouwen slimme oplossingen die daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegen voor onze klanten. Geen eindeloze experimenten of AI omdat het hip is, maar technologie die werkt en impact maakt. We zijn onderdeel van de internationale adesso Group, met ruim 11.500 collega's op meer dan 60 locaties. Tegelijkertijd zijn we in Nederland een relatief klein en persoonlijk team, met korte lijnen, veel vrijheid en ruimte voor eigen initiatief. Groot genoeg om impact te maken, klein genoeg om het verschil te voelen. AI-native: wij omarmen AI, ook in ons eigen werk We geloven dat AI fundamenteel verandert hoe we software bouwen, met data werken en klanten helpen. Daarom bouwen we niet aan losse experimenten, maar aan dataplatformen, AI-first applicaties en agentic oplossingen die echt onderdeel worden van bedrijfsprocessen. Dat geldt ook voor hoe we zelf werken. Met onze Agentic Delivery-aanpak en eigen tools kun je echt vliegen: Context en kennisbank: agents werken met wat er écht speelt bij de klant, en kennis en beslissingen blijven herleidbaar voor mens én agent. AgentOps en governance: zicht op wat agents doen en controle over wat ze mogen, zodat ze veilig en binnen de regels werken. adSCAILE: ons eigen framework waarmee je samen met AI-agents bouwt, geïntegreerd, veilig en traceerbaar, in cycli van twee tot vier dagen in plaats van sprints van weken. Je gebruikt deze tools dagelijks en helpt ze verder te ontwikkelen. adesso is bovendien Select Partner in het Claude Partner Network van Anthropic. En we blijven kritisch: niet alles hoeft met AI. De beste oplossing staat altijd voorop. En misschien wel het belangrijkste: de mensen Je komt terecht in een team waar vakmanschap, ondernemerschap en kennisdeling centraal staan. Je werkt met ervaren specialisten en groeit door in technische visie en in verantwoordelijkheid voor klantrelaties. We houden van collega's die nieuwsgierig zijn, kennis delen en elkaar verder helpen. Mensen die goed zijn in hun vak, maar ook plezier hebben in samenwerken. Je krijgt bij ons vertrouwen, verantwoordelijkheid en de vrijheid om ideeën daadwerkelijk uit te voeren. Wat krijg je van ons? €5.850–€7.150 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur; 8% vakantiegeld; Contract voor 32 tot 40 uur per week; Een leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding naar keuze, bovenop je salaris; 27 vak

Ongeveer 10% van je tijd gaat naar pre-sales en 90% naar delivery; business development is commercieel eigenaar. AI op het snijvlak van commerce, data en operatie Je begrijpt hoe productdata, assortiment, orderstromen, fulfilment, klantenservice en commerciële sturing samenkomen. Denk aan: Agents die productcontent voor duizenden artikelen verrijken en controleren. Een klantenservicetoepassing die retouren en leveringsvragen niet alleen beantwoordt, maar ook de vervolgstappen voorbereidt. Vraagvoorspellingen waar categoriemanagers hun beslissingen op durven te baseren. Wat breng je mee? Aantoonbare ervaring in retail of e-commerce: je kent de processen, data en platformen van binnenuit. Je hebt AI-oplossingen met LLM's en agents ontworpen, in productie gebracht én onderhouden, inclusief evals, guardrails, monitoring en security. Sterk in Python en SQL, en hands-on met minimaal één cloud (Azure, AWS of GCP) en een dataplatform zoals Databricks, Snowflake of Fabric. Je werkt dagelijks met coding agents en beoordeelt kritisch wat ze opleveren. Ervaring in een klantgerichte rol, zoals consultancy, pre-sales, solutions engineering of je eigen startup. Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en Engels. Mooi meegenomen: ervaring met PIM, OMS, ERP of commerceplatformen, en met klassieke ML zoals vraagvoorspelling. Je advies komt met een werkende versie. Geen agent omdat het kan. Soms is de simpelste oplossing de beste, en dat zeg je dan. De AI Engineer gaat de diepte in op bouw, data, MLOps en schaal, en denkt vanaf de klantvraag mee over de juiste aanpak. Tegelijkertijd zijn we in Nederland een relatief klein en persoonlijk team, met korte lijnen, veel vrijheid en ruimte voor eigen initiatief. jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.jd: We're seeking a skilled Machine Learning Engineer to build and deploy production ML systems for the next-generation data management and artificial intelligence platform for maritime domain awareness. Spear AI is a growing defense contracting company dedicated to delivering cutting-edge solutions that support our nation's security. As we expand, we're building a culture where innovation meets mission-critical work. We operate with a flat organizational structure that empowers every team member to make an impact, collaborate directly with leadership, and contribute to projects that matter. Whether you're joining our Hardware, Software, or Services division, you'll work alongside talented professionals who are committed to excellence and advancing the capabilities that keep our nation safe and secure. Spear AI builds sonobuoy sensors that are deployed into the water and collect edge data. We also work with the U.S. Navy to collect and process their SONAR data. You'll have an opportunity to work on real-world projects that directly impact warfighter capabilities and mission success. What You'll Do We're a small team wearing many hats, and you'd have a wide variety of responsibilities that include: Design, train, and optimize machine learning models using PyTorch Deploy models to production environments in the cloud and at the edge Build and maintain ML pipelines for training, evaluation, and inference Integrate machine learning models into real-time and batch processing systems Optimize model performance for accuracy, latency, and resource constraints Implement model monitoring, versioning, and deployment strategies Work with signal processing data and time-series analysis Improve local development and CI/CD for ML workflows using modern tooling and GitHub Actions Who You Are We're looking for someone with strong Machine Learning Engineering skills who shares our most important values: You're fanatical about polish. Every detail matters. You love to make sure your code is linted, formatted, fully typed, and has comprehensive test coverage. You care about correctness. You take pride in the fact that your models perform reliably and downstream consumers trust your predictions. You obsess over performance. You daydream about model latency, throughput, and efficient inference pipelines. You dive deep. It's important for you to really know how things work. You're always building prototypes and setting up experiments to reinforce your understanding. You live on the bleeding edge. You've got a long list of upcoming ML techniques and frameworks you're excited about and can't wait to experiment with new approaches. You're a great teacher. You know how to break down complex ML concepts for a specific audience and make it click with them in a way that gets them excited. Why Work With Us We ship — We don't work on 18-month projects that are irrelevant before they're even finished. Our work has impact — We build products that are deployed to U.S. submarines and integrate with the sonobuoys we manufacture. We're growing responsibly — We have the resources to hire a lot more people, but we don't want to build a massive team of people who don't share our values. We're remote — Work from wherever you want. We collaborate in real time on Slack or asynchronously via GitHub. We're profitable — We aren't burning through cash trying to make the business work. But we also have investors who believe in us and are committed to our success. We care about doing great work — You don't need permission to sweat the details here. We don't take ourselves too seriously — We're building products that make the world safer. But we don't let that get to our heads. Important Skills Several years of experience with Python and machine learning frameworks Expertise in PyTorch for building and training neural networks Experience training and serving models in cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) Proficiency with MLOps practices including experiment tracking, model versioning, and deployment Experience with model optimization for production performance and scale Knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes for containerized deployments Familiarity with REST APIs and model serving frameworks Understanding of CI/CD pipelines for ML systems Strong fundamentals in machine learning including model architecture design, training strategies, and evaluation Nice To Have Experience with reinforcement learning algorithms and applications Digital signal processing experience Background in time-series analysis or sensor data processing Experience with edge deployment and model optimization for resource-constrained environments Familiarity with distributed training across multiple GPUs/nodes Experience with model compression techniques (quantization, pruning, distillation) Contributions to open-source ML projects or research publications Experience in defense, aerospace, or other regulated industries What We Offer Unlimited PTO — Take the time you need to recharge and maintain work-life balance. Dedicated Sick Time — Your health and well-being come first. Comprehensive Health & Benefits — Medical, dental, and vision coverage to keep you and your family protected. 11 Paid Holidays — Enjoy time off throughout the year to celebrate and spend with loved ones. Professional Development — Educational opportunities and resources to help you grow your skills and advance your career. Collaborative Environment — Work directly with leadership in our flat organizational structure, where your ideas and contributions matter. Mission-Driven Work — Contribute to projects that directly support national security and make a real-world impact. Growth Opportunities — Join us during an exciting expansion phase where you can help shape our future. Additional Benefit Opportunities When You Choose Spear AI : 401(k) with company match Onsite / Remote / Flexible work arrangements or hybrid options (position dependent) Relocation assistance (position dependent) Referral bonuses Perform

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.jd:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” Learn more about working at Coinbase.

The ML & Discovery team in Consumer Growth builds the machine learning systems that help millions of customers discover what to trade and engage with next across crypto, equities, derivatives, and prediction markets. Our models and platforms power personalized feed and asset ranking, intelligent notification orchestration, and LLM-driven market insights across the Coinbase app. As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer (L5) you will own end-to-end initiatives across the ML lifecycle, from problem formulation, feature engineering, and modeling to production serving and online A/B experimentation. Partnering closely with Product, Data Science, and Engineering in a high-velocity, data-driven environment, you will shape our team's roadmap, raise our engineering quality bar, and use AI-native workflows to deliver measurable business impact.

What you’ll do: 

  • Own end-to-end machine learning initiatives from problem formulation and offline evaluation to production deployment and online A/B testing, driving measurable lifts in user engagement, retention, and trading activity.
  • Build and iterate on multi-stage recommendation, retrieval, and contextual bandit models that serve personalized experiences to millions of users across crypto, equities, derivatives, and prediction markets.
  • Design intelligent notification orchestration, candidate ranking, and targeting systems that match users with timely, high-value alerts while avoiding fatigue and improving user experience.
  • Develop production LLM pipelines, grounding workflows, and automated evaluation loops that generate accurate, real-time market insights and personalized financial content.
  • Architect resilient, low-latency model serving services and real-time feature pipelines, eliminating technical debt, leading incident response, and raising our operational reliability bar.
  • Partner with Product, Data Science, and Engineering to shape the team roadmap, mentor L3-L4 engineers, and build AI-native workflows and automation that multiply team velocity.

Required Skills and Experience:

  • 5+ years of experience in machine learning engineering and software development, with a track record of shipping production ML systems that move customer and business metrics.
  • Proven track record in one or more relevant domains: recommendation systems, multi-stage ranking and retrieval, contextual bandits, notification targeting, or production LLM applications.
  • Strong software engineering and data skills in a backend language like Python or Go, with hands-on proficiency in modern ML and data stacks (such as PyTorch, GBDTs, Spark/Databricks, Ray, Kafka, and/or Tecton).
  • Deep practical knowledge of offline model evaluation, training-serving skew mitigation, and design/interpretation of online A/B experiments tied to business metrics.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive complex projects end-to-end, make pragmatic architectural trade-offs, and mentor junior engineers.
  • Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

Our flagship product is the world’s largest AI companionship platform , redefining relationships for millions. It is governed by our proprietary moderation system, EverGuard — an internal AI designed to ensure everything we build is safe, ethical, and human-first . And we’re only just getting started! Our Team We are an enthusiastic, passionate and hardworking team of ≈ 100 people. Our founding team has strong entrepreneurial experience building and scaling web products from 0 to IPO. Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO] • 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership • Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO) • Forbes 30 under 30 + Deloitte TechFast50 ’22 & ‘23 Michael Monin [Co-founder & CTO] • 10+ years as CTO / COO (web2/web3), 3 years in AI/LLM • Serial-entrepreneur: MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) and Zipchat (AI Chatbot for E-commerce brands) Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO] • 8+ years in Customer Acquisition & E-commerce Growth • Serial-entrepreneur: Curatible (sold to Blackstone) and MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal] • 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A • Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone) • Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited) • Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited) Your Role Most LLM roles stop at experimentation. Here, the models you improve power experiences for 50M+ users. Most of our traffic runs on self-hosted, fine-tuned open-weight models . On our internal roleplay evals, our smaller fine-tuned models can outperform much larger off-the-shelf models. Your job is to make them better. You’ll join a small AI team led by Marco, our LLM Tech Lead , working closely with our CTO, Product, Web and DevOps teams. You’ll work across data, post-training, evals, and model behavior, taking ideas from failure analysis to production. The problems are real: personalization, character consistency, long conversations, better evals, multilingual behavior, and faster training cycles. If you want to shape model behavior at consumer scale, this is the role. Decide whether the answer is better data, post-training, prompting or classifiers Build training data and evals that directly shape what gets trained next Improve model behavior across personalization, consistency, tone, multilingual and group interactions Ship to production and use real user behavior to guide the next iteration Speed up the training loop so experiments are faster, easier to compare, and more reproducible Your Qualifications You’ve personally post-trained open-weight LLMs for a user-facing product and shipped them to production You’ve worked where AI was core to the product or business , not an experimental side feature Fine-tuning is core to your experience Strong Python, PyTorch and Hugging Face , with hands-on GPU training and debugging You build data and evals yourself and make decisions from evidence You can take work beyond notebooks into production You use AI tools daily in your own engineering work You are fully comfortable working with uncensored models and explicit NSFW content , including harmful material when developing and evaluating moderation system Bonus points Experience with conversational AI, roleplay products, or highly personalized consumer AI Multilingual LLMs Moderation, safety, or adversarial testing Multimodal models Open-source LLM / post-training contributions Why EverAI? 📈 Exponential Growth : From 50M users in 2 years, to 100M next — and 500M beyond 🚀 Track Record of Category-Creating Innovation : We consistently launch world-first AI applications — setting the pace, not following it 🌍 Global Impact : Top-tier user growth, real-world adoption, and cultural relevance 🧠 Proven Leadership : A senior team that’s launched, scaled, and exited & IPO’d multiple scale ups — now fully focused on reshaping AI companionship 👥 Elite Remote Team : 100% remote and built to win — world-class talent from Tier 1 tech companies , with a culture of ownership, velocity, and radical creativity 🛡️ Ethical Core : Our AI ecosystem is governed by EverGuard, our proprietary AI moderation technology , ensuring responsible development at scale What We Offer ✍️ Contract Type: We prefer B2B, but we’re flexible, what matters is long-term commitment and impact 📍 Work From Anywhere: Fully remote. jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.jd: About us People assume the supply chain is an automated, algorithmic system. It is not. It is a large number of people acting as the glue between organisations and systems, doing work the world depends on with tools that have barely changed in decades. Nexcade builds AI agents for those people, starting in freight forwarding, a $210BN industry. Our agents are live in production with some of the leading global forwarders, pricing millions in freight every week, and we are expanding the platform deeper into the shipment lifecycle. We have raised $8.5M to make this a reality. Our founders, Dan and Tasho, spent years at Sedna and Palantir working with supply chain companies on problems like this one. We are backed by top VCs and angels who backed or founded Synthesia, n8n and other world-class companies. How we work Everybody codes, founders included. The whole company is technical, commercial team included, and runs on coding agents. Closely with customers and design partners, so what we ship changes how they operate. At pace. Fast cycles and quick iterations, on the product and on how we work. End to end. If you see something broken or missing, you have the freedom (and the responsibility) to fix it. In person, 4+ days a week in London. We value synchronous communication. Debate rigorously, decide quickly, execute relentlessly. Enjoy the journey. Hard problems, good colleagues. The role We are building the AI platform for freight forwarding and expanding our product surface, and we are hiring software engineers across product, AI and platform to do it. You will build products that do freight forwarding work alongside our customers' teams, operating across the entire shipment lifecycle. You will work across the stack in Python, TypeScript and React, and directly with customers and founders on what gets built. Everyone here works across the stack, but each engineer has a spike: the area where they set the bar for the team. You spend most of your time where yours is, and lean on your colleagues where theirs are. Product: You build best in class products for the core jobs in freight forwarding, one job at a time. You work as a design partner with our customers to understand the work deeply, turn that understanding into a product they would choose over anything else, and feed what you learn back into the platform everyone builds on. AI: You raise the ceiling on what our AI can do and the floor on how reliably it does it. That spans high volume tasks like classification and extraction and deep workflow tasks that run for hours. You design for performance, reliability, explainability and control, set up the gyms and evals to measure them, and build the harness that runs our agents in all of our products. Platform: You own the foundation every product stands on: the runtime for thousands of concurrent agents and workflows, the way they communicate and scale, the controls for how they access data with permissions that hold, and the observability to see and measure all of it. You ensure the rest of the team can move fast without fear. What we look for A spike, with evidence. Something you have been exceptional at and proof of it. We hire on slope rather than years, so there is no experience threshold in either direction. Strong fundamentals. In the AI-assisted era, having good technical judgement is key. You have shipped production systems people depend on, seen them fail and learned from it. High agency and ownership. You take an ambiguous problem, make a call, and see it through. Humility and learning velocity. You want to get better and you change your mind when the evidence says so. Interest in the problem. You do not need a freight background, but you need to find messy real-world operations interesting rather than a chore. Why join You will shape the product, the architecture and the company, working alongside an engineering team from Palantir, Raft, Faculty, UnlikelyAI and Oxford. You will work directly with the businesses using what you build, on AI applied to an industry that has resisted software for decades. You will get meaningful equity, so when this works you share in it. Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

jobs.jd: About the role Linkup is the web search engine built for AI. Our infrastructure crawls, indexes and serves the live web to AI agents, and it’s scaling fast. We’re looking for a top‑tier Machine Learning Engineer to join Linkup and work hand‑in‑hand with our CTO, Denis Charrier , and the rest of the tech team. Your core responsibilities will be to: Design, train and ship ranking and retrieval models for AI agents Design, train and ship ranking and retrieval models for AI agents Bring new ranking signals into the engine, beyond pure relevance Build the evaluation framework that tells us what really improves search quality Optimize model serving for latency and GPU cost Turn customer and benchmark feedback into ranking improvements, with clear before/after numbers Requirements You’re a great match if you: Are excited to help build Google for AI agents- and believe in Linkup’s mission Have strong hands-on experience in information retrieval, ranking or search in production. Build rigorous evals and check the data behind every number Care about latency, cost and reliability as much as model quality Thrive in a fast-paced, high-ownership startup environment Example Projects Ship a new ranking model to production and prove the gain on our eval sets Push our models to the next level: better answers, lower latency, lower cost per query Build and maintain the evaluations framework that measures every change to our search engine Our Stack Python, PyTorch, Hugging Face, vLLM, Ray, Spark / Databricks, Vespa, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, Terraform Details The ideal candidate will play a central role in our engineering team, partnering closely with the founders. The models you ship will decide what thousands of AI products read every day. We offer a flexible remote‑work policy- see the details here . Join us and leverage your expertise to push the boundaries of AI! About Linkup Our Vision We believe in a future of AI agents and the agentic web . These digital entities can create more value for humanity than we ever could alone, but they depend on the internet to operate, collaborate, take action, and gather information. AI agents need web search . To perform well, they require information that is current, reliable, and context‑specific—not the diffuse, steadily aging knowledge frozen at their last training cut‑off. Modern web search is built for humans, not AIs . Instead of trusted facts, it serves links, ads, and click‑bait. People want visually engaging pages; AI systems need structured truth. An AI can absorb oceans of data, while human attention barely skims the surface. Humans think visually and intuitively; AI reasons in latent space. Web 2.0 is sunsetting . The deck is being reshuffled, and the Bing‑Google search oligopoly is crumbling. Indexing ever more pages is no longer the goal; semantically organizing facts for AI systems is. In the coming agentic web, Google’s ad‑driven model has no natural home. Search for AI must be rebuilt from the ground up . We are reconstructing the web as a rigorously structured knowledge layer, mapping every concept, entity, and claim into a coherent semantic graph. This foundation delivers verified facts and rich context to AI instantly, unlocking faster reasoning, higher accuracy, and radically more useful answers for everyone. Humans search Google; AI searches Linkup. Our Mission Reality never stands still, and neither should intelligence. Linkup reconnects language models to a living stream of verified facts, ensuring AIs remain as current and insightful as the world they serve. Our mission is to deliver the world’s freshest, most trusted knowledge to AIs. Our Culture Our culture is built on the following values: Mission . We believe we play a critical role in building the agentic web. We are 100% committed to our mission of bringing the reality of the world to AI agents. Speed . We build fast, we build to last. We get things done, well. Ownership . We empower every team member to take ownership of their projects, ensuring they see them through to successful completion. Teamwork . Our strength lies in our unity. We rely on one another and embrace our diversity as a core asset. Humility . We maintain low egos, showing respect for others and continuously learning from their insights and experiences. We expect all team member to take an active role in shaping our company culture. Our Team We are a small technical team, working shoulder to shoulder to build the web of agents. A bit more about our 3 co-founders: Philippe Mizrahi- Led the development of Lyft’s Autonomous Vehicles marketplace. Previously launched Amundsen , an open source search engine. Denis Charrier - Founding Engineer at Niland, an audio search company (acquired by Spotify), then Staff Engineer at Spotify. 15y of software development experience. Boris Toledano - Led robotics at Carrefour, after 3y at McKinsey & Co working on public affairs and digital transformation. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

jobs.jd: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Research Engineer (Agentic Reinforcement Learning) based in Switzerland. As an AI Research Engineer specializing in Agentic Reinforcement Learning, you will drive research and innovation in next-generation intelligent systems. You will develop advanced reinforcement learning techniques that improve decision-making, adaptive behavior, and performance across multimodal AI architectures. Working with text, images, audio, and other data modalities, you will help build models capable of solving complex, real-world challenges. Your work will involve designing scalable training infrastructure, optimizing reward mechanisms, and improving the reliability of autonomous AI agents. You will explore cutting-edge approaches involving diffusion-based generative models, autoregressive architectures, and unified multimodal frameworks. Through rigorous experimentation and benchmarking, you will push the boundaries of model performance, efficiency, and generalization. This fully remote opportunity offers the chance to contribute to impactful AI research within a fast-moving, globally distributed technology environment. Accountabilities In this role, you will conduct advanced research and develop scalable reinforcement learning systems for multimodal AI applications. Your main responsibilities will include: Research and develop reinforcement learning algorithms for multimodal models, including diffusion-based approaches for image generation, autoregressive models for multimodal understanding, and unified architectures integrating multiple modalities. Design and implement scalable reinforcement learning infrastructure supporting distributed training across complex multimodal systems. Develop and optimize reward modeling strategies to improve training stability, align model behavior with desired outcomes, and prevent reward hacking and related failure modes. Create, curate, and maintain multimodal simulation environments and training datasets to support robust model development, evaluation, and benchmarking. Design and implement rigorous evaluation protocols to measure model performance, monitor progress against established baselines, and validate research improvements. Analyze and optimize policy performance across different modalities by identifying bottlenecks in training, credit assignment, reward optimization, and cross-modal alignment. Investigate emerging reinforcement learning paradigms that enable AI agents to learn more effectively from environmental feedback. Improve model exploration, decision-making, and adaptive behavior to achieve state-of-the-art performance in dynamic, real-world environments. Conduct large-scale experiments and translate empirical findings into practical algorithmic improvements. Publish and present research findings at leading international conferences, including ICML, NeurIPS, ICLR, CVPR, ICCV, and ECCV. Requirements The ideal candidate combines strong theoretical knowledge of reinforcement learning with hands-on experience developing and optimizing large-scale multimodal AI systems. The following qualifications and technical skills are expected: Master's degree in Computer Science or a related discipline. A PhD in Machine Learning, Natural Language Processing, Computer Vision, or a closely related field is preferred. Strong track record of AI research, including publications in leading international conferences. Demonstrated experience conducting large-scale reinforcement learning experiments in multimodal and vision-centric systems, including online reinforcement learning environments. Proven ability to improve domain-specific decision-making and achieve measurable gains in policy performance. Deep understanding of reinforcement learning algorithms and optimization techniques applied to vision and multimodal learning. Strong knowledge of policy stability, exploration strategies, sample efficiency, and optimization in complex, high-dimensional environments involving images, video, and other modalities. Advanced proficiency in PyTorch and modern deep learning frameworks for computer vision and multimodal AI. Hands-on experience building end-to-end reinforcement learning pipelines covering simulation, model training, evaluation, and production deployment. jobs.title: Sr ML Engineer, Admin Central
jobs.jd: Your work days are brighter here. We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too. About the Team We are hiring Sr ML Engineers across two teams. Admin Central is building the future of how administrators work across Workday—turning a fragmented patchwork of tools and disconnected AI into a single, unified experience. Within Admin Central, Workday implementations move from being driven by human effort to being powered by intelligence designed into the platform. The Business Process Optimize (BPO) team powers the underlying platform infrastructure. You’ll build mission-critical distributed systems, high-availability usage pipelines, new agentic functionality, and event-driven data flows across global product regions to ensure enterprise billing integrity at scale. If you're excited to build from scratch, move fast, and transform how thousands of admins work every day, come join us! About the Role Key Responsibilities ML Infrastructure & Pipeline Engineering: Architect, deploy, and maintain end-to-end Machine Learning pipelines—from distributed data ingestion and feature engineering to model training, evaluation, and production deployment. Agentic AI & Recommendation Engines: Design algorithms and LLM-driven recommendation features (e.g., IDD insights, next-best-action models) that optimize agentic workflows and tool usage. Low-Latency Inference & Scaling: Optimize real-time model inference and scoring microservices to ensure sub-second response times across high-concurrency multi-tenant environments. LLM & Agentic Observability: Integrate telemetry and tracing (OpenTelemetry, LangChain, LangSmith) into ML pipelines to track model performance, prompt/response drift, and execution efficiency. Data & Feature Store Architecture: Collaborate with core backend engineers to leverage big data platforms (ClickHouse, Apache Iceberg, Spark) for high-dimensional feature retrieval and analytics. Cross-Functional Leadership: Partner closely with Product Managers, Data Engineering, SRE, and Legal/Compliance to translate complex business and governance requirements into scalable ML solutions. About You Basic Qualifications 8+ years of experience in machine learning development, researching, developing, and implementing advanced machine learning models and techniques, with at least 4+ years focused explicitly on building, deploying, and operating production Machine Learning systems at scale. 5+ years of experience and proficiency in deep learning, natural language processing (NLP), and GenAI/LLM orchestration, utilizing frameworks and libraries such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-learn, LangChain, and LlamaIndex, alongside proficiency in Java, Go, Scala, or C++ for high-performance backend systems. Other Qualifications Data Processing & Pipelines: Strong ability in distributed processing (Spark, Flink, Kafka) and high-throughput columnar/vector storage (ClickHouse, Pinecone, Milvus) to design robust ML data pipelines. AI/ML Expertise: Solid knowledge of RAG architectures, LLM fine-tuning, intent classification, and recommendation engines—applying ML algorithms and Model-Based Design (including MCP tooling and structured agentic execution paths) to multi-agent orchestration, contextual reasoning, and workflow optimization. Data Analysis & Feature Engineering: Experience leading EDA on multi-tenant execution logs to validate prompt/response accuracy and optimize tool usage, paired with strong feature engineering skills for vector embeddings, feature stores, and multi-tenant data isolation. Model Lifecycle: Experience leading model building (foundation model adaptation, prompt engineering, fine-tuning, low-latency inference) and deep understanding of the model development lifecycle, including MLOps platforms (Kubeflow, MLflow, Airflow, SageMaker) for monitoring, latency tracking, and retraining at scale. Technical Stack: Strong proficiency in Python and ML libraries (PyTorch, TensorFlow, NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn, LangChain, LangSmith, DSPy), with experience deploying scalable ML systems in cloud-native production using Docker, Kubernetes, gRPC/REST APIs, and CI/CD under strict high-availability (99.9% uptime) and low-latency SLAs. Team Collaboration: Strong ability to mentor team members, drive cross-functional technical alignment, draft system design specs/model cards, and communicate technical and governance decisions. Education: Bachelor's in Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, or Engineering; Master's or PhD strongly preferred. jobs.title: Senior Applied Scientist
jobs.jd: Meet the team You’ll join the Traffic Control Features team within TomTom’s Automated Driving organization . The team builds the technology that turns real-world observations into reliable map information about traffic signs, traffic lights, stop lines and road markings . You’ll work with applied scientists and software engineers to develop algorithms and machine-learning solutions that detect, position and connect these features to the right roads and driving directions. The goal is to deliver accurate, scalable map content that supports navigation and advanced driving experiences. TomTom measures these features using quality dimensions such as recall, precision, and road-relation accuracy. What you will do: Develop algorithms and ML solutions for traffic signs, traffic lights, road markings, and other traffic-control features, including projects with Computer Vision and Image Recognition. Design and productionize solutions that extract reliable map information from diverse, large-scale and noisy real-world data sources, including car sensor data and unstructured information. Improve how features are detected, positioned, and associated with the correct road/lane and driving direction. Drive measurable improvements in recall, precision, and overall map quality against customer-facing targets. Own components of production pipelines, from input data and feature extraction through evaluation and validated map output. Solve complex problems involving geospatial geometry, map matching, computer vision, image recognition, noisy observations, ground-truth quality, and large-scale evaluation. Run experiments, translate successful approaches into production solutions, and clearly document outcomes. Use AI tools, such as Claude Code, to support problem solving, data analysis, implementation, and engineering productivity. Mentor junior colleagues, provide insightful code reviews, and contribute to hiring. What you will need: 4+ years of professional experience in Applied Science, Machine Learning, algorithm development, computer vision or related field. Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Computer Vision, Geospatial Science, Statistics or another quantitative field. Master’s or PhD is a plus. Strong fundamentals in algorithms and machine learning , including model development, evaluation, statistics and experimental design. Proficiency in Python , an ML framework such as PyTorch or TensorFlow, and large-scale data processing tools such as Spark or Databricks. Experience taking algorithms, ML models or data pipelines from experimentation into production . Experience leading well-scoped technical projects and mentoring junior colleagues. Ability to work across data, algorithms, modeling, ground truth and evaluation rather than operating within only one area of expertise. Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to independently approach complex and ambiguous problems. Proficient written and verbal communication skills in English. You already live in the Netherlands. We cannot offer relocation for this role. What we offer A competitive compensation package, of course. Time and resources to grow and develop, including a personal development budget and paid leave for learning days, as well as paid access to e-learning resources such as O’Reilly and LinkedIn Learning. Time to support life outside of work, with enhanced parental leave plus paid leave to care for loved ones and volunteer in local communities. Work flexibility, where TomTom’ers, in agreement with their manager and team, use both the office and home to focus, collaborate, learn and socialize. It’s all about getting the best out of both worlds – we ask TomTom’ers to come to the office two days a week, and the remaining three are free to be worked in either location. Improve your home office with a setup budget and get extra support with a monthly allowance. Enjoy options to work from your home country and abroad for a set number of days each year, to visit family and friends, or to simply explore the world we’re mapping. Take the holidays you want with a competitive holiday plan, plus an extra day off to celebrate your birthday. Join annual events like our Hackathon and DevDays to bring your ideas to life with talented teammates from around the world. Become a part of our inclusive global culture and have the chance to collaborate with a diverse community – we have over 80 nationalities at TomTom! Find out more about our global benefits and enjoy additional local benefits tailored to your location. Meet your team We’re Maps, a global team within TomTom’s Location Technology Products technical unit. Our team is driven to deliver the most up-to-date, accurate and detailed maps for hundreds of millions of users around the world. Joining our team, you’ll continuously innovate our mapmaking processes, directly contributing to our vision: engineering the world's most trusted and useful map. At TomTom... You’ll help people find their way in the world. In 2004, TomTom revolutionized how the world moves with the introduction of the first portable navigation device. Now, we intend to do it again by engineering the first-ever real-time map, the smartest and most useful map on the planet. Work with a team of 3,300+ unique, curious and passionate problem-solvers. Together, we’ll open up a world of possibilities for car manufacturers, enterprises and developers to help people understand and get closer to the world around them. jobs.title: MLOps Engineer Sênior (ML em Tempo Real)
jobs.jd: Se você tem paixão por inovação e busca trabalhar em um ambiente ágil, colaborativo e desafiador, esta pode ser a sua oportunidade! Para compor nosso time de MLOps, buscamos uma pessoa para liderar a construção da nossa plataforma de ML em tempo real . Ela é a base para que modelos de machine learning, agentes de IA e aplicações tomem decisões em milissegundos, a partir de eventos que acabaram de acontecer em nossos produtos. O desafio é desenhar e construir essa plataforma na AWS e entregá-la como serviço aos times de ciência de dados e de produto. Ela reúne feature store, registro de modelos, inferência em tempo real e monitoramento, para que esses times coloquem modelos em produção com autonomia. Você vai fazer parte da estrutura de plataforma e trabalhar com os times de engenharia de software, de dados e de cloud, do desenho da arquitetura até a entrada em produção. Se interessou pela oportunidade mas não reside em Joinville? Não tem problema, possibilitamos o trabalho remoto/home office. Liderar o desenho da arquitetura da plataforma de ML em tempo real, avaliando alternativas e conduzindo as decisões técnicas com os times envolvidos; Entregar a plataforma como serviço, com padrões, interfaces e documentação que permitam aos times de ciência de dados e de produto definir, publicar e consumir features e modelos sem depender do time de plataforma; Construir e evoluir os componentes da plataforma: a feature store (online e offline, com metadados catalogados), o registro e versionamento de modelos, a inferência em tempo real e o monitoramento dos modelos em produção; Garantir que as features usadas no treinamento e na inferência sejam as mesmas, com a mesma lógica em batch e em streaming, definindo os requisitos com os times de engenharia que constroem os fluxos de eventos; Integrar a plataforma aos serviços de ML da AWS, com o Amazon SageMaker como base para o armazenamento de features, o registro de modelos e a inferência em tempo real; Estruturar a operação da plataforma e dos modelos em produção com os times de Cloud e de Plataforma de Dados, usando infraestrutura como código, padrões e runbooks; Garantir a latência, a disponibilidade e a escalabilidade da plataforma, com SLOs e observabilidade; Documentar decisões técnicas, padrões e procedimentos operacionais, facilitando o crescimento do time e a evolução da stack. Modelos em Tempo Real (Real-Time): Experiência em produção com modelos de machine learning em tempo real, com inferência acionada a cada evento e requisitos de baixa latência. Arquitetura Self-Service: Vivência na entrega de plataforma como serviço, com padrões de arquitetura self-service, documentação e interfaces que deem autonomia aos times de ciência e produto. Feature Store e Consistência de Dados: Experiência na construção de Feature Store (online e offline, com metadados catalogados) e garantia de consistência entre treinamento e inferência. Registro e Monitoramento de Modelos: Prática na estruturação de registro e versionamento de modelos (Model Registry, ex.: MLflow) e monitoramento de modelos em produção. Ecossistema AWS: Experiência na construção de plataformas de dados e ML na AWS, preferencialmente com Amazon SageMaker (Endpoints, Feature Store, Model Registry, Pipelines) ou serviços equivalentes. Linguagens de Programação: Domínio avançado de Python e SQL para desenvolvimento de rotinas de dados e serviços de ML. Engenharia de Software e IaC: Domínio de Terraform (IaC), automação de deploys via CI/CD e observabilidade em produção. Informações adicionais Diferenciais: Produtos Financeiros e Negócio: Experiência com tomada de decisão em tempo real em produtos financeiros (como risco, crédito ou prevenção a fraudes). Arquiteturas de Streaming: Entendimento da construção e consumo de fluxos de streaming (ex.: Kafka, Kinesis, CDC, AWS DMS, MSK) para dialogar com os times de engenharia. Ecossistema Databricks: Vivência no ecossistema Databricks para apoiar e se comunicar com cientistas e analistas de dados. Regulações do Setor Financeiro: Conhecimento das principais regulações do setor (como LGPD, normas do Banco Central/BACEN e SOX). Modelo de trabalho: Carga horária de 8h por dia (segunda a sexta-feira); Contratação CLT. Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer, AI Safety
jobs.location: US, CA, Santa Clara US, CA, Remote
jobs.jd: NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in an inclusive, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world. Serving as an AI Engineer on our AI Safety Engineering team, you will have a key and adaptable role in scaling methods to secure and align advanced AI systems. Your early work will center on architecting and developing the fundamental elements of our safety infrastructure, emphasizing autonomous automation cycles. To operationalize these automated workflows, you will partner with Research and Model Development teams thereby delivering novel models for harm detection, content moderation, dynamic guardrails, post-training, and groundbreaking automated research pipelines that push the limits. This role is built for a tenacious builder and an inquisitive problem solver. We want an engineer who thrives in ambiguity. They must have the grit to overcome complex technical challenges and transform innovative safety concepts from raw ideas to scalable implementations. What You’ll Be Doing: Architect Agentic Automation: Compose, build, and deploy foundational agentic automation loops that streamline workflows spanning safety evaluations, red-teaming, model testing, model post-training and ablations. Develop Safety Models: Move from infrastructure automation towards training and implementing specialized systems for identifying harmful content, coordinating content quality, and run-time guard-railing. Pioneer Auto-Research: Build and guide automated research frameworks. These frameworks use LLMs and autonomous agents to discover new vulnerabilities. They also generate or augment safety datasets for benchmarking or training and propose novel alignment techniques. Scale Innovations: Take proof-of-concept safety interventions and research ideas and engineer them into robust, highly scalable solutions that integrate seamlessly into our production pipelines. Cross-Functional Execution: Partner closely with researchers, platform engineers, and data scientists to bridge the gap between theoretical AI safety research and practical, technically focused automated systems. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), Cyber - NYC
jobs.jd: About the team OpenAI’s Forward Deployed Engineering team builds with customers to bring frontier AI into production. Our Cyber FDEs partner with the security and engineering teams that defend globally critical systems, from enterprise software to the core infrastructure it runs on. Cyber FDEs work closely with our Product, Research, and Go-to-Market teams to adapt our products and models to what customers need to defend their systems. About the role You’ll build systems that give defenders an advantage at a scale few engineering teams encounter. You might help an enterprise identify, test, and deploy patches across hundreds of thousands of code repositories, or help a security team analyze petabytes of logs for signs of malicious agents or coordinated attacks. Across these deployments, you’ll build tools that customer engineers can trust to support consequential security decisions. You’ll work directly with customer security teams, from CISOs to frontline analysts. As AI changes how attackers operate, you’ll help these teams determine where their defenses need to evolve, prioritize what to build, and validate solutions with the engineers who will operate them. Alongside OpenAI’s account teams, you’ll translate security priorities into deployed systems that help defenders cover more ground. You’ll also help shape what OpenAI builds next. When you identify a gap between what defenders need and what today’s models or products can do, you’ll partner with Research and Product to define, build, and test capabilities that address it. This role is based in New York. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week. We offer relocation assistance. Travel up to 50% is required. In this role you will: - Partner with customer security leaders and OpenAI’s Go-to-Market team to scope engagements, establish responsibilities, and define measurable success criteria. - Lead technical design and implementation alongside customer engineers. Integrate agents into security workflows, establish access boundaries, and determine which actions require human review. - Build evaluations grounded in the decisions defenders make. For a patching agent, test whether a fix blocks a known exploit while preserving expected application behavior. For a detection system, replay historical attacks alongside normal traffic to measure detection speed and false-positive rates. - Guide production rollout with the engineers who will operate the system. Provide the observability and controls they need to understand system behavior, intervene when necessary, and expand adoption with confidence. - Translate successful approaches across deployments into reusable tools and engineering practices that other defenders can adopt. You might thrive in this role if you: - 5+ years of software engineering experience, including building and shipping production software. - Experience protecting production systems through work in security engineering, infrastructure, SRE, DevOps, or product engineering. - Experience building and evaluating AI agents for software engineering workflows. - Experience with CI/CD pipelines and practices that maintain code quality, reliability, and security. - Ability to navigate unfamiliar codebases and contribute maintainable, production-quality changes. - Ability to communicate technical concepts and trade-offs to engineering teams and senior security stakeholders. Additional experience Cybersecurity spans many disciplines, and while we’re primarily looking for strong engineering generalists, we’d love to hear about deeper experience in any of the following areas: - Security curiosity and experimentation: You read CVE write-ups because you want to understand how things break. You may have built an agent honeypot to test a hypothesis—or prove a point—and enjoy turning a security question into a hands-on experiment. - Security community engagement: You enjoy exchanging ideas with defenders, whether that’s discussing security strategy with a CISO at Black Hat or comparing technical approaches with frontline practitioners. - Application security: You’ve written CodeQL queries or Semgrep rules, built fuzzing harnesses, or discovered and responsibly disclosed vulnerabilities. - Automated remediation: CI/CD is your happy place. You’ve built tooling that turns security findings into tested patches, dependency upgrades, or configuration changes across large codebases. - Detection engineering: You’ve written and deployed detections using Sigma, YARA, Splunk, or KQL and tested them against attacker behavior. - Cloud and identity security: You’ve designed cloud IAM architectures and investigated abuse of workload identities, role hierarchies, or cross-account trust. - Security research: You’ve reverse-engineered malware, developed exploit reproductions, or contributed to vulnerability research. - Agent security: You’ve tested agents for prompt injection, tool misuse, or credential exposure and built defenses against them. jobs.jd: AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and unwavering support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow. Are you energized to create new markets for GenAI, Machine Learning, and Deep Learning technologies? Do you love scaling new businesses? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is proud to be the pioneer and widely recognized leader in Cloud Computing. Our web services provide IT infrastructure in-the-cloud that is used by hundreds of thousands of developers and businesses around the world. These customers range from start-ups to leading web companies to Global 500 companies in industries such as financial services, pharmaceuticals, and high technology. AWS customers are looking for ways to change their business models and solve complex business challenges with GenAI in the cloud and AWS is leading the way in providing customers with a broad portfolio of GenAI/ML services. AWS is seeking a seasoned Solutions Architect leader to help us scale our GenAI/ML business in Auto/Mfg and Media & Entertainment segments. jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.jd: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Engineer based in Switzerland. We are looking for an experienced AI Engineer to build and deploy production-grade AI systems that address complex challenges across heavy industries, including utilities, manufacturing, logistics, and energy. You will play a key role in developing a next-generation industrial operating system, taking innovative products from concept to production. The role combines agentic AI, multimodal machine learning, industrial data integration, and full-stack engineering. You will work with real-world data from sensors, machines, and operational systems to deliver intelligent solutions that improve efficiency, reliability, and decision-making. This is a high-ownership opportunity in a fast-moving, zero-to-one product environment. You will help establish the foundations of an ambitious platform designed to transform industrial operations. Accountabilities You will design, build, and ship the core AI capabilities of an industrial intelligence platform, connecting advanced models with operational data, enterprise systems, and practical decision-making tools. Develop and deploy agentic AI systems, including orchestration, tool use, state management, and human-in-the-loop workflows. Build agent runtimes and orchestration frameworks supporting specialized agents for vision quality, predictive maintenance, and operations planning. Design context assembly systems using industrial ontologies and memory, including tool dispatch, approval gates, tracing, and cost controls. Develop multimodal data pipelines combining video processing, computer vision, and structured operational data. Implement computer vision capabilities such as object detection, segmentation, and action recognition, using technologies such as YOLO and OpenCV. Process industrial sensor data, including RTSP video, time-series telemetry, vibration, thermal data, and PLC/OPC-UA streams. Build signal-processing and sensor-correlation workflows, including FFT feature extraction and cross-sensor analysis. Design and contribute to industrial ontologies and knowledge graphs representing plants, assets, sensors, work orders, materials, and maintenance histories. Develop memory systems for trace storage, playbooks, asset templates, and reusable failure-pattern libraries. Build operational interfaces such as dashboards, evidence-based alerting workflows, replanning tools, and audit trails. Develop integration connectors for ERP, CMMS, WMS, industrial historians, and PLC systems, ensuring data normalization and consistent schema mapping. Deliver end-to-end solutions spanning data ingestion, model serving, backend services, and frontend interfaces. Ensure production systems meet demanding requirements for reliability, latency, scalability, cost efficiency, and operational usability. Requirements The ideal candidate is an autonomous, hands-on AI engineer with experience taking complex systems from initial development to production, particularly in environments involving physical-world data and industrial operations. At least 3 years of experience building and shipping production AI systems; 5+ years preferred. Proven experience developing agentic AI products and production systems, including orchestration, tool integration, state management, and human oversight. Experience as an early-stage engineer at a venture-backed startup, contributing to products and systems from zero to one. Strong background in AI and machine learning applied to physical-world systems. Experience working with large-scale industrial data, such as video streams, IoT devices, sensor telemetry, vibration, thermal data, or PLC/OPC-UA systems. Hands-on experience building multimodal AI pipelines that combine computer vision with structured operational data. Understanding of data ingestion, normalization, temporal alignment, data quality, and ground-truth challenges in real-world environments. Experience with industrial ontologies, knowledge graphs, or structured context systems based on asset hierarchies and operational processes. Experience integrating AI systems with enterprise and industrial platforms such as ERP, CMMS, WMS, historians, or PLC systems. Strong software engineering skills across backend and frontend development, including Python and TypeScript. Experience with production-oriented technologies such as FastAPI, PostgreSQL, React Native, and OpenCV. A practical understanding of system reliability, failure modes, latency, cost management, and human interaction. Ability to work autonomously, take ownership, and deliver in a fast-paced, high-intensity environment. Strong motivation to solve complex industrial challenges through hands-on engineering and applied AI. Benefits Opportunity to help build a category-defining industrial operating system with the potential to shape manufacturing plants and industrial facilities over the next 10–20 years. Exceptional employee equity package, with an equity pool described as twice the industry standard and an estimated value of more than $200,000 from day one. Opportunity to work alongside an experienced team with backgrounds in enterprise technology, industrial robotics, autonomous driving, and academic research. Exposure to complex, real-world industrial challenges and large volumes of underutilized sensor data. Direct impact on operational efficiency, predictive maintenance, industrial reliability, and decision-making across major industries. jobs.title: Research Engineer - Data Infrastructure
jobs.jd: About ElevenLabs ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. How we work High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. What we offer Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. About the role We are looking for a Research Engineer to join the research team at ElevenLabs, focused on the data infrastructure that powers our frontier AI models. The quality of our models is bounded by the quality and scale of the data behind them, and you will own the systems that make world-class data possible. You will thrive in this role if you enjoy: Building large-scale data pipelines for collecting, processing, filtering, and transforming datasets used to train state-of-the-art models. Training models used in our data processing pipelines, such as classifiers, quality filters, and labeling models. Designing data curation strategies such as deduplication, quality scoring, labeling, and augmentation that measurably improve model performance. Creating tooling and infrastructure that lets researchers explore and train on massive datasets quickly and reliably. Requirements We do not require any formal certifications or degrees. Instead, we are seeking enthusiastic engineers who can showcase solving impressively hard problems with artifacts such as past projects, designs, or GitHub contributions. Ideally, you bring: Experience building data-intensive systems, ideally in support of machine learning training pipelines. Strong engineering skills in distributed data processing at scale (e.g., Kubernetes, or custom pipelines over large datasets). The capacity to autonomously evaluate how data quality, composition, and curation affect model outcomes, and to build the tooling to measure it. Bonus: Experience building or operating web crawlers. Location This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, San Francisco, and Warsaw. #LI-Remote We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses. We are bridging human creativity with artificial intelligence to transform every aspect of the advertising lifecycle, from ad creation and optimization to performance analysis and customer insights. We are a passionate group of innovators dedicated to developing responsible and intelligent AI technologies that balance the needs of advertisers, enhance the shopping experience, and strengthen the marketplace.
